about.title: About MERIDIAN
about.subtitle: A boutique watch house devoted to precision, heritage and quiet luxury.
about.heading: Founded in precision, defined by restraint.
paragraphs: MERIDIAN began in a small Geneva workshop with a simple conviction: a great watch should do one thing — tell time beautifully. No gimmicks, no noise, only the quiet confidence of a movement that runs on time, every time.
Today our timepieces are assembled by hand from the finest Swiss and Japanese movements, each one individually regulated, tested and certified before it earns the MERIDIAN signature.
points: 2–5 year international warranty on every timepiece
